name: Can a backyard guest house increase property value?

mainEntity.name: How much value does a backyard guest house add to a Los Angeles property?
mainEntity.text: How much value does a backyard guest house add to a Los Angeles property?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backyard guest house can add significant value, but the lift depends on quality and usability. Buyers respond more strongly to a permitted, well-designed unit that looks and functions like a real part of the property than to a cramped or awkward add-on. In Los Angeles, the strongest value cases usually come from homes that gain flexibility for family use, guests, office space, or rental income. The design should therefore focus on livability, privacy, and cohesion with the main house. A poorly planned unit can add cost without delivering much resale benefit, while a thoughtful one can expand the market for the home and make it more competitive.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-designed backyard guest house can add value by increasing usable living space, flexibility, and rental potential. The value boost depends on whether the unit is permitted, how well it matches the property, and whether it feels like a true independent living space rather than an afterthought.
